metric: Pairs proved equivalent by the z3 prover over all databases meeting the declared keys and NOT NULL columns, with no LLM. Inequivalent pairs stay out of this count.
correctness: 0 false proofs: every proof survives 1,000 further random DuckDB databases and VeriEQL's published counterexamples replayed on DuckDB
caveats: Full corpus (23,994 pairs). No labels. MySQL source run on DuckDB; 1,071 pairs are not run (DuckDB rejects them, mostly a table name the schema spells differently and GROUP BY positions that name aggregates). Search settings were tuned on a 1,000-pair sample (every 24th pair), so the other pairs are held out from that tuning. Measured on master 7b7ba13 (harness translation #347, HAVING-only wider search #356); prover rules merged later (cast_rules.py and after) are not rerun yet. VeriEQL refutes pair 21215 without a replayable counterexample; read by hand, it is equivalent (GROUP BY 1 vs GROUP BY the key, IS NOT NULL on the primary key). 2026-10-04: 6 proofs fewer (4,793 to 4,787): the parser check refuses the pairs whose MySQL text uses `||` as OR (MySQL's default reading; sqlglot reads concatenation), found by re-running the 17 pairs it refuses on master and on this branch, not by a full rerun (docs/parser-checks.md). 2026-11-12 (commit 97e4a0e, whole corpus in six chunks of 4,000 with --audit, 0 wrong): 4,787 to 9,022 proved. The gain is not all from one change: it includes every prover rule merged since 2026-10-02 and the harness fixes (two primary keys, consecutive ids), which were not measured one by one. Measured on the problems this batch worked on, before and after its rules on the same base (prover only, so every pair of the problem): 1084 9 to 178 of 918; 614 96 to 340 of 544; 1677 0 to 282 of 437; 1587 475 to 531 of 774; 182 84 to 150 of 265; 1809 192 to 496 of 575; 1468 85 to 97 of 670; 1715 178 to 179 of 442; 585, 183, 1045, 1173, 1435 and 1783 unchanged. Every newly proved pair of those problems (1,134 of them, measured on the batch's earlier commit) was re-checked by the harness, which searches 1,000 further databases: all equivalent or unknown because DuckDB rejects the query, none wrong. Many unproven pairs of these problems agree with the reference on every database tried but differ on a NULL the generated databases never contain (a nullable foreign key or CHECK column); they stay unknown. The refuted count fell from 5,676 to 5,129 since 2026-10-02 (see verieql-leetcode-executed); the cause was not separated. After main moved again, the merged commit e7ad6b7 was checked on every 24th pair (1,000 pairs): the same 384 proved, 208 refuted, 364 agree, 44 not run as in the whole run on 97e4a0e, 0 wrong. The rest of the corpus was not rerun on e7ad6b7. 2026-11-16 (string-literal checks): the 883 pairs the change reaches were run on the base and on the change, not the whole corpus. None lost a proof; 12 that agreed on every database are now proved (9 development, 3 held out), each through the harness's 1,000-database recheck, because a declared DATE column compared with two date strings is no longer sent through the numeric reading. They are not added to the count above, which stays the whole run on 97e4a0e. 2026-11-18 (the 2026-11-11 worker rules merged with main edb3ae3, commit e75c9a3; whole corpus in twelve slices of 2,000 with --audit, the base side being main eaf4899 measured the same way on 2026-11-17, 0 wrong): 9,113 to 10,848 proved (+1,735, none lost, 0 wrong; refuted unchanged at 5,129). The 9,113 is main eaf4899 with every rule merged until then; main edb3ae3 (the hardest-cases batches 4 and 5) was not itself run on the whole LeetCode set, so the gain over it is not known pair by pair: the candidate is 146 proofs above the earlier candidate dd53ffe (10,702), which came from main's batches 4 and 5 and the date fixes. The new proofs are the rules of docs/evals/verieql.md (2026-11-17); the harness gave every one of them equivalent. The 12 pairs of the 2026-11-12 note above are in this run's count.
held_out: Every fifth pair (index % 5 == 0, 4,799 pairs) was never read while writing the 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-12 VeriEQL rules (join_distinct_aggregates, keyed_group_filters, key_group_choice, duplicate_values, anti_membership_joins, and the earlier aggregate_membership, rank_filters, extreme_joins, extreme_rows, keyed_lookups); 1,789 of its pairs are proved (37.3%) against 7,233 of the other 19,195 (37.7%). Search settings were tuned on every 24th pair (1,000) in October; those overlap both groups. On 2026-11-18 the held-out pairs of the 2026-11-11 worker rules (1783, 1468, 614, 1045, 1809, 182, 183) were never read either: in the whole run 2,133 of the 4,799 held-out pairs are proved (44.5%) against 8,715 of the other 19,195 (45.4%), and the branch gained 325 held-out proofs against 1,410 development ones (main eaf4899: 1,808 held out).
